|game_text=Deploy on a site. Unless a player controls a battleground site, that player’s [Permanent Weapon] weapon destiny draws are -2. During opponent’s draw phase, if opponent’s non-battleground site (with no related locations) on table, may activate or retrieve 1 Force. (Immune to [[Alter]].)
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E3, the current text (version 4 of 4): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List of 2013, which prints the original release-sheet words again. The image here is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1250-25-front-master.png]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Wipe Them Out, All Of Them (V)]]): Virtual Block 5 release sheet, official text as of 7 December 2009 (slip 24)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock5">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf#page=3 Virtual Block 5 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"; copy re-made 1 April 2010), page 3, slip 24. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095234/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf#page=3 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on a site. Unless a player controls a battleground site, that player’s [Permanent Weapon] weapon destiny draws are -2. During opponent’s draw phase, if opponent’s non-battleground site (with no related locations) on table, may activate or retrieve 1 Force. (Immune to Alter.)” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB5-24-Wipe_Them_Out_All_Of_Them.png]]) prints it. The slip prints slip number 24 at the bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Wipe Them Out, All Of Them (V) (Errata)]]): PC website card list, Virtual Block 5 list and Virtual master list, in every archived capture with game text, 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013<ref name="cl-1250_25">Players Committee website card list (Internet Archive captures): VBlock5Type (Virtual Block 5 list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205224/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111153832/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 11 January 2013]; VMasterType (Virtual master list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 January 2013]. Later captures carry no game text.</ref>: “Deploy on a site. Unless a player controls a battleground site, that player’s [Permanent Weapon] destiny draws are -2. During opponent’s draw phase, if opponent’s non-battleground site (with no related locations) on table, may activate or retrieve 1 Force. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' One change: “weapon” after the [Permanent Weapon] icon is dropped (“[Permanent Weapon] destiny draws”). The Players Committee generated the website card list from its Holotable card data, so this wording is that data's transcription of the card; the Players Committee published it on its own website, so it is a version. Icons written out in words, straight single quotes and credit lines in the list are not changes; the text here draws the icons as the printed slips do. The list shows no slip image.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Wipe Them Out, All Of Them (V) (Errata 2)]]): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB5-D-wipethemoutallofthem-pre.gif]]), on the Players Committee's server by 25 February 2013<ref name="pc-img-date-Virtual5-Dark">Players Committee card image folder (<code>Virtual5-Dark/large/</code>), web-server directory listing sorted by date: every file last modified 25 February 2013, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034650/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual5-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A 18 August 2019] (Internet Archive); the file is byte-identical to today's.</ref>: “Deploy on a site. Unless a player controls a battleground site, that player’s [Permanent Weapon] weapon destiny draws are -2. During opponent’s draw phase, if opponent’s non-battleground site (with no related locations) on table, may activate or retrieve 1 Force. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' it prints the original release-sheet words again, word for word, undoing the card-list changes listed under PC-E1. The date is the bulk upload date of the whole image folder, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (versions ruling of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is a version at its upload date, and what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It prints the same slip number as the release-sheet slip (24).
* '''PC-E3''' (this page): Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 33)<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=33 Internet Archive]</ref>, slip [[:File:VL-history-1250-25-front-master.png]]: “Deploy on a site. Unless a player controls a battleground site, that player’s [Permanent Weapon] weapon destiny draws are -2. During opponent’s draw phase, if opponent’s non-battleground site (with no related locations) on table, may activate or retrieve 1 Force. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' it prints the original release-sheet words again, word for word (the same words as the PC card image, PC-E2). The Master List slip prints no slip number. Every published text is a version, even a word-for-word repeat (versions ruling of 11 November 2026).
